tagline: 理光取景器相机，1992 年发布
description: 理光于1992年推出的取景器相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度mechanical, 1/125 sec. (fixed-speed)。感光度manual setting, ISO 100 / 200 / 400 / 1000。fixed focus with infinity setting facility。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.对焦: fixed focus with infinity setting facility
specs.曝光测光: fixed exposureA particular aperture is selected according to the film speed regardless of the light conditions
specs.取景器: reverse Galilean type, 0.52 X, 80% field of view
specs.闪光灯: activated automatically in dim light, range: 1~3 m, recharge time approx. 6 sec., no flash-off facility
